public_title: R17 produced a recoverable return; selected-capacity acceptance failed
public_summary: Training and source work were preserved, but the execution did not satisfy the selected-capacity utilization requirement. Return packaging completed successfully. The observed bottleneck was resource admission, with one core admitted during the representative measurement despite 48 requested. This is a completed partial execution, not a claim of current process activity.

public_counters.label: recoverable physical returns in the recent R16/R17 pair
fully accepted executions in that recent pair

count_scope: Fit credits are the R17 typed optimizer-ledger categories; they are not counts of unique model or numerical weight identities. The recent-run tally covers only R16 and R17. The representative utilization window is a subset of the full run and is not added to these fit counts.
public_limitations: The complete official season denominator, full-population champion selection and provider comparisons remain separately qualified in the population report. Repeated numerical inputs across roles require distinct fit-accounting review; publication does not promote a model.
